Eiffel Tower Closed Amid Protest Over Female Staff Removal

The Eiffel Tower in Paris was temporarily closed and reopened after a staff protest concerning allegations that female employees were asked to leave their workstations during a visit by a Hindu religious delegation. Union representatives reported that women staff were asked to step out of sight. This led to a staff protest and prompted an investigation by authorities. The tower has since reopened.
